name: Tenshi
source: A girl with one wing. She calls herself Tenshi, but whether she has a real name or not is unknown. By flapping her wing, she is able to float slightly. Working part-time, storing a large amount of cup noodles, she lives a surprisingly down-to-earth life. Sometimes, as if she remembers something, she tends to look up at the sky, reaching out her hand.
